Climbing the heights comes easy as the chitin hooked cut into stone and wood alike.
Arboreal Grip While using the Hooked Vambrace to climb, you have Advantage 
on Strength (Athletics) checks for climbing.
Crescent Claw If you hit a Medium or smaller creature with this weapon, you can 
force the creature to make a Strength Saving Throw (DC 10 + the Ability Modifier 
used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). Failure: The creature has 
the Grappled condition.

Fitted to slice hide and fur with a quick slash, but don't run too fast while carrying them.
Running with Scissors During a Dash Action when wielding a pair of Silv Sheers, 
you may choose to slash creatures within 5 ft. of your movement. Dexterity Saving 
Throw: DC 13, the wielder. Success: Target creature takes 1d4 Slashing damage. 
Failure: You instead takes 1d4 Slashing damage since running with scissors is 
dangerous.
Scavengers Slice The wielder has Advantage on Survival checks when Scavenging 
the Hide or equivalent skin of slain creatures.

Light, durable and sharp edged, the jaw makes for a reliable woodsman's tool.
Wood Chopper While wielding this weapon, you deal double damage to wooden 
objects. Additionally, when you score a Critical hit against a creature wielding a 
wooden shield or wearing wooden armor, that item takes a permanent -1 penalty 
to its AC. The penalty is cumulative, and the item is destroyed if its AC bonus is 
reduced 0. Magical wooden shields and armor are immune to this effect.

Viciously curved to cut in deep, the karambit can hook into flesh and pull the victim close.
Severing Slice When you Critical hit a target creature. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 
15, target creature. Failure: The target creature has their movement speed halved, 
this effect until the target receives healing or succeeds on a DC 13 Medicine check.
Hooked If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make 
a Strength Saving Throw (DC 10 + the ability modifier used to make the attack roll 
and your Proficiency Bonus) to violently embedded the blade into the creature. 
Failure: 3 (1d6) Slashing damage and the Crescent Carver remains embedded 
in the target and is unable to be wielded. The embedded creature takes 3 (1d6) 
Slashing damage at the beginning of their turn and can remove the Crescent 
Carver with a DC 13 Strength test.

Agile and whip-fast, the rapier bends and twists with a flick of the wrist.
Lithe Spine Reaction Trigger When you are the target of a melee attack of a 
creature you can see. Response - Add 1d4 to your AC. If the attack misses, you can 
make melee attack roll with the River Run Rapier against the attacking creature.  
Aquatic Agility You must soak the rapier in water for at least 1 hour a week to 
retain its supple form and ability to perform the Lithe Spine Reaction.

Versatility is the key to evolutionary success, and to surviving a fight.
Flipping Heads Before attempting an attack roll, announce whether your will hit 
with the Aukh Horn (Bludgeoning) or Illithisk Mandible Blade (Slashing) end.
Auhk Crush If your attack is a Critical hit, the target creature has the Prone 
condition.
Illithisk Cleave If your attack is a Critical hit, you may deal half the damage you 
rolled to another creature within 5 ft. of the original target.

Whether splitting stone or shell, the pick axe is as durable as the beasts its scavenged from.
Piercing Tooth If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature 
to make a Constitution Saving Throw (DC 10 + the ability modifier used to make 
the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus) to lodge the weapon into the creature. 
Failure: 3 (1d6) Piercing damage and the Khantooth remains pierced in the target 
and is unable to be wielded by the user. The pierced creature takes 1 Piercing damage 
at the beginning of their turn and can be removed with a DC 12 Strength test. 
Mining Pick If used while on a Foraging Expedition, you get a +1/-1 adjustment 
bonus to the results.

The long beak, reinforced with chitin tarsi, and shatter and break the toughest shell. 
Forced Wedge If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can use your Bonus 
Action to force the creature to make a Strength Saving Throw (DC 10 + the ability 
modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus) to push the 
spear deeper. Failure: 1d10 Piercing damage and the creature is pushed back 5 ft.. 
Success: Half damage.

Just like the draffer, lateral slices with the gauntlet can be made with lethal ease. 
This bladed gauntlet grants you a +1 bonus to attack rolls and leaves your hands 
free. In addition, if you are equipped with two Tuskinners, and make a two-
weapon fighting attack, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll 
of the second attack, even if you do not have the two-weapon fighting style.

Evolved not to cut, but to ravage, the nicalliath's horn is not a subtle tool for killing.
Serrated Thrust When you hit a creature with this weapon. Constitution Saving

damage and has the Bleeding condition for 1 minute. A bleeding creature takes 2 
(1d4) Piercing damage at the start of its turn and will stop bleeding if it receives 
any healing.

The sharp barbed bone, perfectly suited to hook nearly anything in the Fenlands.
Piercing Throw When a thrown mirelance hits, it remains embedded in the 
target and may not be used until pulled freed from the target. Until the barbed 
head is removed, the harpooned creature will take 1 Piercing damage per turn at 
the beginning of its turn. The barb can be removed by taking an Action to pull or 
cut out the barbed head, causing 1d4 Piercing damage when removed. 
Reel You can use a Bonus Action to retract the harpoon's rope up to 20 ft., pulling 
the pierced creature closer to you. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength 
Saving Throw or be pulled up to 20 ft. towards you and takes 1 Piercing damage.
